% 23.03.2023 CM APPL. 14192/2023 -Ex.
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. The present appeal preferred by the insurer under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
seeks to assail the award dated 21.12.2022 passed by the learned MACT insofar as it relates to the quantum of compensation.
Mr. Jha accepts notice on behalf of respondent nos.1 to 3 and submits that respondent no. 2 has expired on 19.01.2023 leaving behind only respondent nos. 1 & 3 as his Class-I legal heirs.
The said statement is taken on record and the respondent no. 2 is, accordingly at the oral request of learned counsel for respondent nos. 1 to 3, deleted from the array of parties.
Amended memo of parties be filed within one week.

5. Keeping in view that no recovery rights have been granted in favour of the appellant, no notice is required to be issued to respondent nos. 4 & 5.
6.
In the meanwhile, let the LCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.

sentences.text: This is an application preferred by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

Taking into account that the claimant is primarily aggrieved by the quantum of compensation awarded by the learned Tribunal, the application is disposed of by directing the appellant to deposit 70% of the awarded amount with the learned Tribunal within six weeks with a further direction to the learned Tribunal to release the same in favour of respondent nos. 1 & 3 in terms of the disbursal scheme contained in the impugned award.
9.
Subject to the appellant depositing the amount in terms of this order, the operation of the impugned award will remain stayed during the pendency of the present appeal.
